selection_mode: configuration supplied by the outer runner; this estimator only selects training-internal epochs

feature_schema.hydrogens: RDKit implicit/explicit H counts; no AddHs
feature_schema.stereochemistry: canonical-isomeric traversal chiral tag/permutation, CIP and bond stereo/direction mapped back to original indices; no completion
feature_schema.stereo_atom_index_mapping: RDKit canonical SMILES _smilesAtomOutputOrder; original input atom/bond indices retained
feature_schema.mixtures: multiple disconnected input components are rejected
feature_schema.occlusion: remove both directed edges; retain original atoms and atom features

epoch_selection_metric: ROC-AUC on grouped holdout within the fitting subset
refit_policy: fresh initialization at same seed; all fit rows; fixed selected epoch; fixed learning rate
probability_aggregation: arithmetic mean of member sigmoid probabilities

members.model_definition:
GINE(
  (input): Linear(in_features=221, out_features=256, bias=True)
  (layers): ModuleList(
    (0-3): 4 x GINELayer(
      (edge_projection): Linear(in_features=33, out_features=256, bias=True)
      (update): Sequential(
        (0): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
        (1): ReLU()
        (2): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
      )
      (normalization): SafeBatchNorm1d(256, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, bias=True, track_running_stats=True)
    )
  )
  (pool_gate): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
    (1): Tanh()
    (2): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=1, bias=True)
  )
  (predictor): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
    (1): ReLU()
    (2): Dropout(p=0.2, inplace=False)
    (3): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=1, bias=True)
  )
)
